collection_context.cover_assets: Changed rendered CDN URLs attempted via supported cloud-browser media download. Successful downloads are byte-validated and content-deduplicated; failures retain current source URLs but null repository paths, hashes and fetch times.
collection_context.provenance_assembly: Section selection evidence independently reconstructed from the same-run captured headings, selected tab and per-card section link. Entity-only metadata cache excludes all section and metric observations.
